message.reasoning_content: Ringo composed none; but Ringo wrote... "Don't Pass Me By," "Octopus's Garden." None listed. But "I Want You (She's So Heavy)" attributed Lennon. Closest: Revolution 9 (Lennon–Ono)? Hmm. The question expects one answer—Ringo co-wrote? None. Maybe "Maggie Mae" credited all four? Not listed. Revolution 9 Lennon-Ono-Harrison. Pick Revolution 9? Low probability. Actually Lennon-McCartney credited to both per contract. So technically all four Lennon-McCartney songs are composed by Ringo too (credit-wise). Ask Me Why is Lennon-McCartney. Revolution 9 is not. So answer Ask Me Why with moderate probability.
